# Eustace .T. Madawu — Freelance Software & Website Engineer

> Eustace .T. Madawu is a freelance software & website engineer from Harare,
> Zimbabwe, working remotely with clients worldwide. He designs, builds and
> ships full-stack websites, web applications and products end-to-end:
> UI/UX, frontend, backend, databases, payments and deployment.

Hire him: email foreigncartelthe7nth@gmail.com with your idea and scope for a
quote and timeline.

## Key facts

- Role: Freelance Software & Website Engineer (remote, worldwide)
- Based in: Harare, Zimbabwe
- Also: technopreneur, trained counsellor, event organiser
- Education: B.Tech (Hons) Electronic Commerce, Harare Institute of Technology
- Languages: English, Shona, Mandarin (business)
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, TanStack Start, Tailwind CSS,
  SQL/NoSQL databases, payment integrations, cloud deployment

## Products (shipped & live)

- Makeke — B2B logistics & marketplace platform connecting bakeries/pastry
  producers with retailers, cafés and event vendors in African cities.
- Hit Campus Guide — interactive way-finder for the Harare Institute of
  Technology campus: https://becomingaman2000-ship-it.github.io/hitarnav/
